hero.title: Get clear. Get moving. Get hired.
hero.subtitle: I help mid-career professionals in South Africa find work that actually fits them — not just the next paycheck.

about.title: A little about me.
paragraphs: I spent 12 years in HR at two of SA's biggest banks. I watched brilliant people burn out because they were in the wrong role — not because they weren't good enough.
Now I work one-on-one with professionals to help them figure out what they actually want, then go get it. No fluff. No 'find your why' retreats. Just clear thinking and real steps.
